name: AvenuesAI Ltd
title: AvenuesAI Ltd - 539807 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Payments-to-AI/lending narrative with no capacity or pricing data; FY26 consolidated revenue INR8,116 cr (+103%) but net revenue only +15% to INR603 cr, and management declined to give FY27 numbers.

summary.headline: AvenuesAI FY26 consolidated revenue from operations rose 103% to INR8,116 crores and PAT 58% to INR332 crores, while net revenue grew 15% to INR603 crores.
summary.overview: Management framed FY26 as the year its payments, merchant, consumer, AI, regulatory and international building blocks came together, and positioned the company as an AI-first fintech infrastructure platform. Q4 FY26 revenue from operations was INR2,490 crores (+115% YoY, +5% QoQ), net revenue INR149 crores (+11% YoY), and adjusted PAT INR95 crores (+90% YoY). Management said FY27 profitability would not show a "hockey stick" and guided consolidated margins similar to or slightly higher than current levels, with formal FY27 guidance deferred to the Q1 call. Lending was reframed as asset-light, with minority stakes in NBFCs (Ratnaafin, up to 2.5%) and a proposed investment in Online PSB Loans; the company said it will not deploy its balance sheet into lending.

financial_highlights.change: +103% YoY vs INR3,923 crores in FY25
+15% YoY vs INR526 crores in FY25
+58% YoY vs INR209 crores in FY25

segments.name: Payments (CCAvenue)
segments.commentary: Growth driven by merchant wins and higher TPV across utility, government and B2B payments; management says it is deliberately taking processing volume from existing merchants, at a cost to take rate. Management also flagged payment gateway margin pressure.

segments.name: Platform / e-commerce platform business
segments.commentary: Full-year platform segment described as flat to slightly higher; Q4 showed a quarterly decline per an analyst. Management expects FY27 growth from new product suites and international rollout of the platform framework.

segments.name: Rediff / RediffPay
segments.commentary: Confidential DRHP filed for Rediff; no financials or timelines shared. RediffPay consumer UPI app is live in production and being scaled; management said most Rediff business is currently B2B.

segments.name: International / XDuce
segments.commentary: XDuce is a 20% associate (not a subsidiary), reported as share of associates, not revenue. Middle East focus in FY26; US to be pursued in FY27. Management did not give an international revenue figure.

guidance_outlook: No formal FY27 profitability guidance; management said FY27 profitability would not show a hockey stick and would be broadly similar to past years, with full-year guidance promised on the Q1 FY27 call.
Consolidated margins expected to continue at similar levels or slightly higher, per management.
Take-rate improvement targeted but requires significant work; investment in Rediff ecosystem and AI continues, with costs front-loaded.
FY27 framed as a year of ecosystem integration, AI deployment, merchant monetization and US expansion.
capex_capacity: Management declined to give a consolidated capex guidance number, citing internal capex guidelines and policies; capex for NBFC investments not quantified.
AI capex stance: company sees its role in compute as limited (not a chip designer), focusing on algorithms and data.
Investment in AI infrastructure, regulatory capabilities and international expansion continued through FY26 but no amounts were disclosed.
Hospitality product scaling to more than 3,000 hotels with central reservation system and payment gateway; form builder onboarded more than 5,000 merchants in under a month.
demand_pricing: TPV growth attributed to merchant wins in Q4 and higher share of wallet from existing merchants; utility, government and B2B payments cited as growing well.
Platform-plus-payments bundling (form builder, hospitality CRS integrated with Opera/Micros-Fidelio and OTAs) cited as growth driver for stickiness.
Payment gateway business faces margin pressure; company said it is consciously accepting lower take rates to win processing volume.
Enterprise AI adoption described as slow by management, which admitted it was 'slightly ahead of our time' on AI approach; no MSAs yet with large US financial institutions.

qa_highlights.question: What are the top three use cases driving TPV growth, and what balance-sheet exposure is planned for lending?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said merchant wins and higher share of existing merchants drove TPV across utilities, government and B2B. It will not put its balance sheet into lending; it will take selective minority stakes in NBFCs, starting with Ratnaafin (up to 2.5%), targeting NBFCs with a few thousand crores of AUM.

qa_highlights.question: Will operating leverage show up in FY27 profitability?
qa_highlights.answer: Costs are front-loaded for AI and new opportunities, with leverage seen in pockets. Management said there is no hockey stick in FY27 profitability and FY27 is expected to look similar to prior years; guidance will come on the Q1 call.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the e-commerce platform segment degrowing, and what are the Rediff IPO timelines?
qa_highlights.answer: Platform segment is flat to slightly higher on a full-year basis; growth expected in FY27 from new products and international. Rediff has filed a confidential DRHP and management cannot share further details due to regulatory compliance.

qa_highlights.question: Can Rediff line items (revenue, EBITDA) be disclosed separately, and what is capex guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Rediff capex policies cannot be shared; consolidated margins expected similar or slightly higher. Management agreed to consider the request for Rediff line-item detail but gave no figures.

qa_highlights.question: How much transaction routing is AI-assisted versus rule-based?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said AI is used across practically all payment areas including fraud checks, and that all transactions have some AI-based check component; no percentage was given.

qa_highlights.question: Will AI revenue be disclosed as a separate line item?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said AI revenue exists but is not material to the P&L; AI is embedded across processes. It agreed to consider disclosing AI-related process breakdowns and expects to share more AI revenue details this year.

qa_highlights.question: Does control shift to orchestration platforms as AI agents execute commerce?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said customer intent and merchant guardrails remain in control; AvenuesAI acts as infrastructure provider and the agent custodian, with two-factor authentication kept with the customer.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the XDuce investment and the 30% international revenue target?
qa_highlights.answer: XDuce is a 20% associate reported under share of associates; management said it does not allocate XDuce's funds and XDuce is profitable, earning a few million dollars annually. Management acknowledged enterprise AI adoption has been slower than expected and said it was wrong on timing.

risks_watch: Payment gateway take-rate and margin pressure as the company prioritises TPV share over pricing.
Front-loaded AI, international and Rediff investments may weigh on consolidated margin; FY27 margin guidance pending Q1 call.
Rediff IPO timing and disclosure: confidential DRHP filed, no financials shared; analyst requested segment-level revenue and EBITDA.

XDuce investment: capital deployments by XDuce unrelated to stated objectives per analyst; international revenue 30% target (set Feb 2024) not met per analyst; management did not give international revenue figure.
Cyber and AI security risk: management acknowledged ongoing concern over new AI-driven vulnerabilities and data compliance (DPDP).
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on strategy (AI-first, asset-light lending, Rediff), but evasive on hard numbers: capex, Rediff financials, AI revenue, XDuce deployments and international revenue targets were not quantified. Management conceded enterprise AI adoption and its own timing had been slower than expected.
key_quotes: We are not going to put our balance sheet for lending.
We do have specific AI revenue as well, which from a size of the P&L is not material, but we think that there's a lot more potential in that.
So we think that that's -- it's a bet worth making. It's one that we won't get all our bets right in terms of timing.
I think that's an incorrect statement. We don't participate in the Board of XDuce and we don't allocate the funds.

growth.why: No formal FY27 guidance; management said profitability will not show a hockey stick and consolidated margins should be similar or slightly higher, with full-year guidance deferred to Q1 FY27 call, and no specific capacity or order figures were given to back growth.
